name: Stormbringer: Heavy Winds and Concentrated Static native effect mods (#2054, #2157)
contract: #2054: Heavy Winds (567542) effect1 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3), EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1 = 15, EffectSpellClassMask word2 32768 (0x8000) overlapping Stabilizing Pressure's (572399) own SpellFamilyFlags word1/word2 (16777216/32768). Effect0 is the same aura/op11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) with EffectBasePoints -1+1=0, an inert filler. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12149-12168) routes SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 to effect index 2 of the affected spell inside SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue; Stabilizing Pressure's own effect index 2 is SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK with EffectBasePoints 34 + EffectDieSides 1 = 35, confirmed today via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset, so Heavy Winds must raise it to 35+15=50. #2157: Concentrated Static (570722) effect0 is aura 107, MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), EffectBasePoints 4+1=5, EffectSpellClassMask word1 4096 (0x1000) matching Discharge's (805288) own SpellFamilyFlags word1 exactly. SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 routes to effect index 1, which on Discharge is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT with EffectBasePoints 14+1=15 (confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer), so Concentrated Static must raise it to 15+5=20. Both are plain SPELLMOD_EFFECTn-on-classmask-matched-spell mechanics (parity contract bullet 7): the engine's own SpellInfo effect-value calculation applies them without any module code, independent of PR #4612's pending spell_bonus_data restoration (which touches damage/DoT scaling coefficients, not these percentage effects).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
